title: My Alcoholic Grandfather
synopsis: The strong Baiju is perhaps one of the most well-known Chinese spirits. This is the story of a grandfather who really enjoys his Baiju.

fullText.simplified:
我的“酒鬼”爷爷

    爷爷是一个乐观、幽默、年近八旬的可爱的“小老头”，年轻时吃了不少苦，但他一直用自己的方式享受着生活。就拿喝酒来说，他几乎每天都喝三次白酒，一共差不多一斤，大家都知道白酒的度数都在50度左右，可想而知，每天一斤酒对他的健康有多大的威胁，医生给过他不少警告，可他从没真正听进去，奶奶有时候看不过去，还是会唠叨几句“喝酒有害健康”之类的话，他常常默不作声地继续喝，有时喝得兴致高起来了，他会淡定地回答：“喝白酒是我最大的乐趣，不让我喝酒，活得长那是受罪！”奶奶竟然无言以对，此时我的“酒鬼”爷爷酷毙了！
fullText.traditional:
我的“酒鬼”爺爺

    爺爺是一個樂觀、幽默、年近八旬的可愛的“小老頭”，年輕時吃了不少苦，但他一直用自己的方式享受著生活。就拿喝酒來說，他幾乎每天都喝三次白酒，一共差不多一斤，大家都知道白酒的度數都在50度左右，可想而知，每天一斤酒對他的健康有多大的威脅，醫生給過他不少警告，可他從沒真正聽進去，奶奶有時候看不過去，還是會嘮叨幾句“喝酒有害健康”之類的話，他常常默不作聲地繼續喝，有時喝得興致高起來了，他會淡定地回答：“喝白酒是我最大的樂趣，不讓我喝酒，活得長那是受罪！”奶奶竟然無言以對，此時我的“酒鬼”爺爺酷斃了！

sentences.traditional: “喝白酒是我最大的樂趣，不讓我喝酒，活得長那是受罪！”

sentences.traditional: 奶奶竟然無言以對，此時我的“酒鬼”爺爺酷斃了！

raw.synopsis: The strong Baiju is perhaps one of the most well-known Chinese spirits. This is the story of a grandfather who really enjoys his Baiju.
sentence_translations: My grandpa (from my father’s side) is optimistic, humorous and a lovely old man almost in his eighties.
Although he went through a lot of hard times when he was young he has always been enjoying life in his own way.
Take drinking alcohol as an example, he nearly drinks three times everyday - a total of about half a kilogram.
As everybody knows the alcohol strength of Chinese Baijiu is usually around 50%, ..
.. which without doubt will be a big threat to his health.
His doctor gave him warnings but my grandpa never listened.
Sometimes my grandma gets fed up (because of his ignorance towards his health), ..
.. so she would nag him by saying something like: “Drinking alcohol is bad for your health”.
Most of the time my grandpa kept drinking silently.
When his spirits go up, he would respond:
“Drinking alcohol is the biggest joy in my life. Without it, living longer will be just torture to me!”.
My grandma becomes speechless but I think my alcoholic grandpa is super cool.
